title: Provisioning request (hub -> integration)
description: Asks the integration to make sure the device has its own HA user with exactly one long-lived access token and to deliver that token via POST /api/integration/client-token. Sent as WS push provision_client and repeated in GET /api/integration/status provisioning[] until the hub has the token. Handling MUST be idempotent: token_action=ensure reuses the device's existing token (a new access token is derived from the same refresh token, refresh_token_id stays the same); only token_action=rotate mints a new one.

request_id.description: Correlation id for logs; not used for deduplication.

token_action.description: ensure: create user/token if missing, otherwise re-deliver the current token. rotate: mint a new token for the same user; the integration removes the old one only after the hub acknowledged the new one.

reason.description: Why the hub asks (logging, UI). pair = newly paired device (status pending); retry = earlier request unanswered; rotate = admin rotate-token; guest_extend = guest extended beyond the token lifetime; reprovision = the hub has no usable token for an active device (e.g. restored backup).
